Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Elections

Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 123 as introduced will increase the expenditures of the Secretary of State by an estimated maximum amount of $5,000 annually to print and distribute the affidavits required by this bill.
Bob Fincher, Chair
